description.ja: 『境界戦機』から、海老川兼武氏デザインの北米同盟軍のミリタリーテイスト全開の量産型AMAIM(アメイン)ジョーハウンドがHGにラインアップ！
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki", the mass-produced AMAIM Jawhound, designed by Kanetake Ebikawa and fully displaying the military taste of the North American Alliance Army, is now available in the HG lineup!

description.ja: ■専用ライフルはマガジンとグレネードが着脱可能。
description.en: • The special rifle has a detachable magazine and grenade.

description.ja: ■頭部シャッターの開閉で駐機状態、表情の変化を再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the parked state and changes in facial expressions by opening and closing the head shutter.

description.ja: ■ハンドパーツは２種付属。武器持ち手は手甲パーツをスライドしナックルモードを再現。
description.en: • Two types of hand parts are included. The weapon holder can be recreated in knuckle mode by sliding the gauntlet parts.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ 武器持ち手(左右)、平手(左右)
accessories.en: Hand parts Weapon handle (left and right), open hand (left and right)

accessories.ja: ライフル(グレネードランチャー装備)×１
